milestone.title: Raul TUI visual overhaul — syntax highlight, icons, rich detail rendering

intent.outcome: The raul TUI milestone detail view renders lightweight markdown formatting (bold, code, lists, rules) with syntax highlighting, status indicators use configurable icons with visual weight, and step/AC progress is conveyed by proportion bars and color-coded badges instead of bare text.

problem.description: The raul TUI today renders all milestone detail text as flat monochrome paragraphs — body fields (description, problem, scope) have no formatting, list items blend into prose, and AC/step status is conveyed by plain text labels only. (Note: an earlier draft of this spec claimed M54 shipped empty; that is inaccurate — M54 raul TUI v2 is in the pending-review queue. M86 stands on its own merit: the TUI genuinely lacks typography and visual hierarchy today.) The icon system (status_icon in config.rs) is underutilized — only three statuses use it while lanes, board cards, and detail views use hardcoded symbols. M85 activates the theme palette and icon config plumbing; this milestone builds the typography, iconography, and progress indicators on top of that foundation, hence depends_on: [85].

in_scope: Lightweight markdown renderer for milestone detail text: **bold**, `code`, bullet lists (-/*/+), numbered lists, --- separators
Apply syntax highlighting to milestone body fields (description, problem, scope) in the TUI detail view
Enrich icon set: lane-specific icons in sidebar, board card status icons, list-item status markers (using the status_icon system wired in M85)
Add step progress bar to milestone detail (e.g. [=====>    ] 7/12 steps done) via extracted pure fn compute_progress_bar
Add AC progress bar with color-coded pass/fail/pending states (using palette colors from M85)
Color-code spec_status and execution_status badges with visual weight (not just text labels)
Improve detail view spacing: add padding between sections, indent nested content
Cache parsed markdown on app state so rendering does not re-parse every frame
Edge-case handling in the parser: unmatched delimiters, empty input, nested markers — no panics
out_of_scope: Full CommonMark or GFM compliance — this is a lightweight renderer, not a markdown engine
Custom icon packs beyond the existing Unicode/ASCII/None modes
Dashboard/status page redesign (already clean in M71)
Theme palette activation and --color flag work (prerequisite, done in M85)
Robustness fixes for drill-in/panic/truncation (covered by M87)

acceptance_criteria.description: A markdown renderer module (e.g. crates/raul/src/tui/markdown.rs) parses inline **bold** into a bold Span and inline `code` into a distinct-color Span. Test feeds "**hi** and `code`" and asserts the styled spans exist with the expected modifiers/colors.

Bullet lists (-, *, +) and numbered lists (1.) render with indentation and a colored bullet/marker token. Test feeds "- a\n- b\n1. first" and asserts indentation prefix and marker styling on the output Lines.
A line that is exactly --- renders as a horizontal rule (a Line of box-drawing or repeated - characters spanning the detail width). Test feeds "\n---\n" and asserts a rule-styled Line is produced.

Step progress bar renders as a string like [=====>    ] 7/12 where the filled proportion = done/total. A pure fn compute_progress_bar(done: usize, total: usize, width: usize) -> String is extracted and table-tested for edge cases: 0/0 (no division-by-zero), 0/N, N/N, total<width.

AC statuses are color-coded in detail: passed=green, failed=red, pending=yellow via palette colors (not hardcoded Color:: tokens, since M85 moved rendering onto the palette). Test asserts the style lookup maps each status to the expected palette color.

Sidebar lanes and board cards use the status_icon system from config.rs (honoring ui.icons = unicode/ascii/none) instead of hardcoded symbols. Test: with ui.icons=none, lanes/cards render no icon glyph; with unicode, they render the configured icon.
Detail sections have consistent vertical spacing — a blank Line between sections, no sections running together. Manual visual review confirmed via screenshot or recorded TUI session.
acceptance_criteria.verification: manual: accepted — visual spacing requires human review

acceptance_criteria.description: Markdown parser handles edge cases without panic: unmatched **, unmatched `, empty string, nested *``**, and a body with only whitespace. Test feeds each and asserts a non-panicking render with best-effort output.
Markdown parsing runs once per detail load (cached on app state), not on every render frame. A test or debug counter asserts the parser is invoked at most once per milestone detail load.
All existing raul tests pass (cargo test -p raul); new tests cover markdown rendering, progress bar computation, and icon config.

steps.action: Create markdown parsing module (src/tui/markdown.rs): parse **bold**, inline code spans, bullet lists (-/*/+), numbered lists, --- separators into ratatui Spans/Lines

steps.action: Integrate markdown renderer into render_milestone_detail: replace flat Paragraph rendering of description, problem, scope with markdown-parsed output
steps.done_when: Milestone detail shows bold text in bold, code in distinct color, bullet lists with indentation, and hr separators

steps.action: Add unit tests for markdown parser: bold spans, code spans, bullet/numbered lists, separators, mixed content, edge cases (empty input, unclosed delimiters)
steps.done_when: All markdown parser edge cases have passing tests

steps.action: Add step progress bar to milestone detail: compute done/total from step statuses, render a proportion bar (e.g. [====>   ] 7/12) with palette colors
steps.done_when: Milestone detail shows step progress bar with correct done/total count and visual proportion

steps.action: Color-code AC statuses in milestone detail: passed=palette.success, failed=palette.danger, pending=palette.warn; render as colored badge not just text
steps.done_when: AC list in milestone detail shows green/red/yellow badges per status

steps.action: Add spec_status and execution_status badges: render as colored labels (ready=green, draft=yellow, in-progress=cyan, done=green, blocked=red) in milestone detail header
steps.done_when: Spec/exec status in milestone detail header are color-coded badges

steps.action: Add section padding and visual separation: consistent vertical spacing between intent/problem/scope/ACs/steps sections, indentation for nested content
steps.done_when: Detail sections have consistent spacing; no sections visually bleed together

steps.action: Extend sidebar lane labels: add lane-specific icons (using status_icon pattern) to each lane entry in the sidebar renderer, honoring icon mode config

steps.action: Add board card status icons: render spec/exec status icons on each card in the review board, consistent with the status_icon system
steps.done_when: Board cards show colored status icons matching the icon mode; changing icon mode refreshes board icons

steps.action: Add icon rendering tests: verify all lanes, statuses, and board cards produce correct icon strings for each IconMode (Unicode, ASCII, None)
steps.done_when: Tests pass for all three icon modes across lane labels, status markers, and board cards

steps.action: Add progress bar computation tests: verify done/total counts, empty milestone (0/0), all-done milestone, mixed statuses
steps.done_when: Progress bar unit tests pass for edge cases
